proved_claims.scope: Any exact collinear physical spectral bank; compresses the bank into one genuine independent normalized product-linear scalar with density cap sqrt(e).
Exact rank-three target; one null spectral ray is filled to total Parseval mass one by arbitrary many original coordinates; arbitrary transverse Parseval frame.
After consumed mass s on a spectral ray, a next row alpha v has whitened leverage alpha^2/(1-s); each >1/2 step cuts remaining ray mass by more than half; nullness is invariant under whitening.

first_unpaid_implication.statement: For a null-ray bank of mass w in (1/2,1), control the exact overlapping complement leakage of norm sqrt(1-w) using original product provenance and the orthogonality of the normalized residual ray coefficient with the two transverse coefficient vectors; conditional density caps alone are insufficient.

next_mechanism: Exploit the exact three-vector orthogonality in the complement before conditioning: either a product-origin curved-trace estimate uniform in rho=1-w, or an exact angular/cross-volume dichotomy. Do not treat small rho perturbatively.
